stem.text: The number of people inside a museum is modeled by a differentiable function N of time t, measured in minutes, whose rate of change is \( N'(t) = - \frac{15 e^{- \frac{t}{8}}}{4} \) people per minute, for \( 0 \le t \le 24 \). Using a calculator, find \( N'(4) \), showing the setup, and interpret the value in the context of the problem with correct units. Give the value correct to three decimal places.

answer_key.label: \( N'(4) = -2.274 \), so at time t = 4 minutes the number of people inside the museum is decreasing at a rate of 2.274 people per minute.

worked_solution.text: With a calculator, \( N'(4) = -2.274 \) to three decimal places.
worked_solution.rule_named: evaluate the derivative at the instant

worked_solution.text: The value is negative, so at time t = 4 minutes the number of people inside the museum is decreasing at a rate of 2.274 people per minute.
worked_solution.rule_named: sign of the rate gives the direction of change

options.label: \( N'(4) = -2.274 \), so when the number of people inside the museum is 4 people it is decreasing at a rate of 2.274 people per minute.
options.derivation: the independent variable never named, so the input is read as a value of the quantity rather than a time

options.label: \( N'(4) = -2.274 \), so at time t = 4 minutes the number of people inside the museum is decreasing at a rate of 2.274 minutes per person.
options.derivation: the units assembled the wrong way round, time units over the units of the quantity
